criteria.semantics: A native <figure> holding an element of role img named by the visual's label (aria-label), and a <figcaption> with its description in words: what the picture shows is there as text.

keyboard.outcome: Passes it by: it is not a stop in the tab order.

criteria.name: The visual's label.
criteria.group: The description, in the figure's caption.

setting.statement: WHEN I set my text size to 200% I SEE the caption grow with it, with no loss of information.
WHEN I zoom the page to 400% I SEE the visual scale down and its caption wrap, with no horizontal scrolling.

check.statement: The face emits a native <figure> element.
The picture is one element of role img.
The picture is named by the visual's label in aria-label.
I SEE the description in a <figcaption> under the picture.
A visual is not a control: nothing in it is a stop in the tab order.
WHEN I reach the visual with a desktop screen reader (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) I HEAR its label and the role of image, then its caption.
WHEN I swipe to it with a mobile screen reader (TalkBack, VoiceOver) I HEAR its label and its caption.

criteria.semantics: The window draws no picture: a visual falls back to text, its label and description in fg on bg. GPUI exposes no accessibility tree, so the text does not reach assistive technology.

keyboard.outcome: Passes it by: it is not a stop in the tab order.

criteria.name: The visual's label, as text.

setting.statement: WHEN I set my system text size to 200% I SEE the label and description grow with it, with no loss of information.
WHEN I magnify the window with the system zoom I SEE the text whole.

check.statement: I SEE the visual's label and description as text in its place.
WHEN I reach the visual's place with a screen reader (VoiceOver, Orca, Narrator) I HEAR its label and its description.

criteria.note: GPUI 0.2.2 exposes no accessibility tree (no AccessKit): every HEAR check fails on this face today. Its SEE checks with a probe run on GPUI's test platform (gpui/src/native.rs), which no CI job runs yet (gpui/README.md, Verification); the rest are reported as not verified.
